name: where-is
description: Answer 'where is X', 'who uses X', 'what file handles X' questions on TypeScript/JavaScript monorepos by classifying the query (symbol / structural-pattern / path-glob / broad-concept) and routing it to the right tool — Serena MCP for symbols, ast-grep for AST patterns, git ls-files for path globs, ripgrep for concepts. Replaces 5-10 Explore-subagent calls per question with one structured answer grouped by workspace package.
